_note: Image models, kept apart from models-registry.json because they are a different kind of thing:
several files with named roles rather than one GGUF plus expert packs, and no bit-exactness claim
to make. The engine is stable-diffusion.cpp as published, unpatched, so nothing here is certified
the way a text model is. What IS here is measured: every `measured` entry below is a run on real
hardware, timed, with the image checked by eye. Nothing is listed that has not produced a picture.
Each download entry carries a url and the name it lands under, because the files of one model come
from different repositories and one of them has to be renamed: there are two files called
sdxl_vae.safetensors in the world and only one of them works in half precision.
Flux.1-schnell is deliberately absent. Its published GGUF weights denoise to noise on the current
engine and its VAE fails to allocate on Metal, so it would ship as a grey square. It goes in when

models.name: Stable Diffusion XL
models.note: 1024 square, the quality option. The separate VAE is the fp16-fix one: the original produces black images in half precision.

models.name: Stable Diffusion 1.5
models.note: 512 square, under two gigabytes, and quick. The one to start with on a smaller Mac.
